name: Thunder Orb
summary:
You launch a slow-moving orb of lightning that passes through enemies. Every 0.25s it zaps up to 3 enemies in range, dealing Lightning damage. It prefers enemies it hasn't zapped yet. If it hits a wall, it stops there and keeps zapping until its duration (3s base at max lvl, 2s base at lowest lvl) runs out.

How the targeting works: every tick fires its 3 zaps no matter how many enemies are in range.
- In a mob: zaps spread to new targets, so the orb sweeps damage through the pack as it travels.
- Fewer than 3 enemies: the extra zaps go to enemies already in range.
- Lone boss: all 3 zaps hit the boss every tick.
